_source: Binding rules for the lifted SEC-EDGAR templates in this directory (declarative_spec.templates.generate_bindings; drawn with random.Random(bindings_seed), so a seed gives the same list every time). GenDB publishes no substitution parameters for its SEC queries, so each parameter is drawn from the column's actual domain on holdout/gendb_sec_edgar/duckdb/sec_edgar_dec.duckdb (read 2026-11-08), restricted to the values that carry at least 1 % of the rows the comparison filters, so a drawn instance is never a near-empty query. Each list contains the query's own value, so binding by hand to it gives back the GenDB query (the template header's comment names those values).

_domains.num.uom: non-NULL num.value rows per uom: USD 33,234,006, shares 3,091,826, pure 1,364,900 (each >= 1 % of 39.4M); the next, CAD, has 339,308 (0.9 %)
_domains.sub.sic: an SIC division range [d*1000, d*1000 + 999] (q4's 4000-4999 is d = 4): d in 1..8, each >= 1 % of sub (division 1 4,802 rows ... division 8 3,398); division 0 (574 rows, 0.7 %) and NULL (1,215) are left out
_domains.tag.abstract: tag.abstract is 0 in all 1,070,662 rows: the only value
